intro: Maine Root Fountain Soda at CAVA offers a refreshing, naturally crafted beverage made with pure cane sugar and carbonated water. At just 160 calories per 16 oz serving, this premium soda provides a clean, crisp taste that perfectly complements any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). Made with simple, quality ingredients and no artificial additives, it is a standout choice in the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks).
priceCalories: Priced at $3.25 for a 16 oz serving, Maine Root Fountain Soda contains 160 calories with 42g of carbohydrates, 0g of protein, and 0g of fat. This makes it a straightforward beverage choice when you want something sweet and refreshing. The calorie count comes entirely from cane sugar, providing natural sweetness without artificial sweeteners or high fructose corn syrup.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Maine Root Fountain Soda apart is its commitment to quality ingredients. Made with carbonated water, pure cane sugar, and natural flavors, this soda avoids artificial ingredients and high fructose corn syrup. The result is a cleaner, more authentic taste that feels less processed than conventional sodas. Maine Root has built its reputation on crafting premium beverages that taste great while maintaining ingredient integrity.
nutritionFacts: Each 16 oz Maine Root Fountain Soda contains 160 calories, all from 42g of carbohydrates. With 0g of protein and 0g of fat, this is purely a carbohydrate-based beverage. The sugar content comes from cane sugar rather than corn syrup, providing a different sweetness profile. For detailed nutritional information across all beverages, check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to plan your meal.
whatsInside: Maine Root Fountain Soda contains just three simple ingredients: carbonated water for effervescence, cane sugar for sweetness, and natural flavors for taste. This minimal ingredient list means you know exactly what you are drinking. There are no artificial colors, preservatives, or flavor enhancers. The transparency in ingredients reflects CAVA's commitment to offering quality beverage options alongside their [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains).
tasteLike: Maine Root Fountain Soda delivers a classic, crisp soda taste with natural sweetness from cane sugar. The flavor is clean and refreshing without the chemical aftertaste sometimes found in sodas made with artificial sweeteners or high fructose corn syrup. The carbonation level is perfectly balanced, providing satisfying fizz without being overwhelming. It offers authentic soda flavor that pairs wonderfully with Mediterranean cuisine.
customize: Maine Root Fountain Soda comes ready to enjoy at 16 oz with no customization needed. However, you can enhance your beverage experience by requesting extra ice for a colder drink or no ice if you prefer full volume. Consider pairing it with fresh lemon wedges from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) for added citrus brightness. The straightforward nature of this beverage makes it easy to enjoy exactly as served.
pairsWell: Maine Root Fountain Soda pairs excellently with bold, savory dishes from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) and [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas). The sweetness balances spicy harissa or tangy feta nicely. It also complements rich proteins and creamy dips from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). The crisp carbonation cleanses your palate between bites, making it ideal for flavorful Mediterranean meals.
healthyChoice: While Maine Root Fountain Soda contains 160 calories and 42g of sugar, it uses cane sugar instead of high fructose corn syrup and avoids artificial ingredients. This makes it a cleaner choice among sodas, though it should still be enjoyed in moderation. If you are watching sugar intake, consider the lower-calorie Blueberry Lavender option at 140 calories or water. Always check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for dietary considerations.
howToOrder: Ordering Maine Root Fountain Soda is simple. When visiting any [CAVA Locations](/locations), just request the Maine Root Fountain Soda in 16 oz at the beverage station or when placing your order. It is available for dine-in, takeout, and delivery. The soda comes already portioned and ready to enjoy. Pair it with any bowl, pita, or salad for a complete meal experience with refreshing carbonation.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade at 260 calories and $3.45, Maine Root Fountain Soda offers fewer calories at 160 and costs less at $3.25. Blueberry Lavender provides a slightly lighter option at 140 calories for $3.45. Maine Root stands out for its classic soda experience with natural cane sugar, while lemonade options offer citrus-forward flavors. Each beverage brings unique taste profiles to complement your meal preferences.
whoShouldTry: Maine Root Fountain Soda is perfect for anyone who enjoys classic soda but prefers natural ingredients over artificial additives. If you appreciate craft beverages made with cane sugar and want something fizzy to complement your Mediterranean meal, this is an excellent choice. Soda enthusiasts who value ingredient quality and those seeking familiar flavors with a premium twist will particularly enjoy this beverage option.
worthTrying: Maine Root Fountain Soda is definitely worth trying if you want a premium soda experience at CAVA. At $3.25 for 16 oz, you get quality ingredients, authentic flavor, and the perfect complement to Mediterranean cuisine. The use of cane sugar and natural flavors creates a cleaner taste that elevates your meal. For soda lovers seeking better ingredients without sacrificing flavor, this beverage delivers excellent value and satisfaction.
